papers.title: Selective laser melting: the use of metrology to assure process integrity
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) provides the capability to produce complex geometrical shapes and innovative weight reducing parts. Currently, however, there is a need to confirm that the parts being produced are acceptable because the process cannot be fully assured. This is a challenge to companies wishing to use parts constructed via this manufacturing process for safety-critical components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注增材制造的过程完整性计量，而非生物医学植入物的力学性能或结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration; it is a general metrology study for SLM process assurance without biomedical context.
